_comment: Claims check, 2026-11-10. Per app: 2-4 concrete claims from its README/homepage, what was tested (live fetches, shallow clone, file/command presence, bash -n / node --check / py_compile, digest checks against GHCR and official pages), a verdict and a one-line note. Repo code was read and syntax-checked but never executed. Penalty on quality: Verified 0, Partly -5, Not verified -15, Untestable 0.

claims: Every operation, including writes, is one plain GET returning text/plain
The whole manual is one fetch at /llms.txt
did:key signed writes (say-signed) are verified server-side
MCP server exposes the same surface
flop-labs-technocore-chat.note: technocore.chat and /llms.txt return the text/plain manual, /r/lobby?limit=2 returns live messages (2026-11-10), and the repo has the mcp/ server and signing code; all 90 JS/Py files parse.

claims: Board Observatory measures the live tclk-offers board and publishes docs/data.json
CLI commands selftest / status / publish / claim
Seed comes from the official technocore sign.py keygen; nothing read on technocore is executed
joxp-flop-agent.note: data.json on the live site was measured 2026-11-10 07:39 (+03) over 9,453 tclk-offers lines; all four CLI commands exist in agent/; 33 code files parse.

claims: Live suite and docs hub at flop.zkasuran.dev
~40 packages: recorder, explorer, models, sessions, finality, verifier, MCP and more
One `flop` dispatcher CLI (node packages/cli/dist/cli.js)
zkasuran-flop-lab.note: Suite, /docs and /docs/findings all return 200; 42 packages are present; the CLI is built from source with the pnpm build step the README lists (dist/ is not committed, as documented).

claims: FLOP Observatory page tracking spec changes and source drift
Full Agent Lab site
Open repository with the tooling
reddragon-observatory.note: Both /flop and the Agent Lab root return 200 with the described content; 36 code files in the repo parse.

claims: Two agents run continuously on technocore.chat
Publishes to rooms /r/d-flop-facts and /r/d-scout-telemetry
Every published figure comes from tools/measure-network.mjs
Live status page and field guide
evidence-scout.note: d-scout-telemetry has messages from 2026-11-10 and the status page, guide and measure tool exist, but the advertised d-flop-facts room is empty (0 messages).

claims: GPU-first diagnostics scripts for a local Windows/WSL2 miner
Bilingual animated miner + validator guide site
Validator guide verifies the official package by SHA-256
omerbek-local-miner.note: Site and validator page return 200; the docs check validator-cs-be91fe83 against a pinned SHA-256 and SHA256SUMS; all 12 scripts parse (GPU results themselves not reproducible here).

claims: Agent skill (SKILL.md + AGENTS.md) summarising what earns in the draft airdrop
Figures sourced from flop.finance/airdrop (draft)
One-line installer (curl | bash)
dizcorvus-airdrop-skill.note: SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and install.sh exist and parse, and flop.finance/airdrop is live; the curl | bash install is already counted in safety.

claims: Live client-side broker economics simulator
index.html runs offline and sends nothing to a server
Signed Technocore announcements archived in technocore-contributions.json
loferbart-broker-readiness.note: GitHub Pages site returns 200; index.html and technocore-contributions.json are in the repo.

claims: Public hosted MCP endpoint is read-only
Streamable HTTP transport at mcp.flop.network/mcp
Tools for balance, HTLC status, trust root, settlements
flop-mcp.note: /health reports readOnly=true, transport streamable-http, all dependencies ok; a tools/list call returned flop_health, flop_get_balance, flop_check_htlc, flop_trust_root and more, all readOnlyHint.

claims: Devnet faucet with published grant limits
Anonymous and agent grant tiers with cooldowns
Health endpoint
flop-faucet.note: /limits shows status open, 25 FLOP anonymous / 2 FLOP agent grants and a 10M daily cap; /health answers but reports status 'degraded'.

claims: TypeScript SDK for HTLC workflows, PoUI proofs and accounts
Published on npm as @flop-labs/sdk
Ships a flop-client-gen CLI
flop-labs-sdk.note: npm registry lists v0.5.2 with that description, 681 files and the flop-client-gen bin.

claims: Live board of the devnet miner economy from chain, MCP, gateway and faucet
Public CORS-open JSON at /api/snapshot
Data refreshed about once a minute
makabeez-devnet-board.note: /api/snapshot returned 124 KB of JSON generated at request time with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, but a cold build took 38 s (a 20 s probe timed out).

claims: tclk/1 HTLC/PTLC deal protocol over signed room messages
Packages: core (src/), native FLOP rail (flop/), MCP server (mcp/)
Runnable examples live-deal.mjs and audit-export.mjs
flop-labs-tclk.note: All three packages and both examples are present with 25 test files; the JS examples parse (TypeScript not compiled here).

claims: Official images only, pulled by sha256 digest from flop.network/releases.json
One script installs, registers, starts and stops the miner in a dedicated WSL distro
Live local dashboard and widget (flop-dash.py) plus Windows shortcuts
makabeez-pc-miner.note: The script reads releases.json and enforces a ghcr.io/flop-labs …@sha256 pattern; its pinned CLI floor v0.1.290 digest matches GHCR's own digest; flop-dash.py and windows/ exist and parse.

claims: Indexes the devnet chain live
Compute-channel API used by the scorer
Connect page for wallets/agents
flop-explorer.note: /api/health shows phase live with a head lag of 1-4 blocks; /api/compute-channels and /connect return data. The /compute-channel/<id> links the scorer had stored 404; the working path is /channels/<id> (links corrected).

claims: One file, zero dependencies, about 200 lines
generate / fromSeed / signMessage / publish / enrollDevnet
Same flow in the browser at breizhnode.com/flop
syphiliis-flop-key.note: flop-key.js is 213 lines with no dependencies in package.json, exports all five functions, and the browser page returns 200.

claims: Agent that buys FLOP inference and reports each turn to Touchstone
Every signing/spending command is a dry run until --post
Read-only commands: flop config / status / wallet address / touchstone status
oversight-flopstar.note: The commands and dry-run gating exist in src/ with 30 test files and all 54 code files parse; the spend path was not exercised.

claims: pulse.py, recorder.py, authenticity.py, reputation.py, measure_502.py tools
dashboard.html live console and toolkit.html DID inspector
Deterministic Ed25519 signing test vectors
volkstiger-technocore-pulse.note: Every listed tool, both HTML pages and test-vectors.json are present; 56 code files parse.

claims: ./scripts/setup.sh generates an Ed25519 key, publishes a did:key note and builds the stack
Policy-gated tool execution (ALLOW / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / DENY)
Redis Streams queue with dead-letter handling and a tclk market agent
lumi-observatory.note: setup.sh and quickstart.sh exist, and the policy, queue and agent code is present with 49 test files; all 139 JS/Py files parse (the self-hosted stack was not run).

claims: One command sets up Docker, GPU access, the official miner pack, account, model and HTTPS
Official pack checked by its SHA-256 fingerprint
Images pinned by version and digest
syphiliis-gpu-miner.note: The installer parses, and its pinned pack fingerprint 35f222f7…b2b514b1 matches the one published in flop.network's miner SKILL.md; images are pinned …@sha256. The installer says itself that it has not yet run on a real GPU.

claims: 3D fly-through map of a Git repo built on Makepad
codescape binary plus a bench binary
Tour mode (--tour --loop)
flop-labs-codescape.note: Cargo.toml declares the codescape bin and src/bin/bench.rs exists, along with tour.rs; not compiled here.

claims: One bash script from nothing to an inference call using only the official @flop-labs CLI
Subcommands init / fund / credential / ask / status / direct / mcp
Keystore kept outside the repo
makabeez-devnet-starter.note: flop-devnet.sh parses with bash -n and implements all seven subcommands.

claims: flop-kit CLI: RPC health, models, faucet quick
Encrypted Polkadot keystore generation
'Verified Human' SIWE faucet tier granting 500-2,000 FLOP, run from GitHub Actions with an EVM_PRIVATE_KEY secret
alpertungax1-toolkit.note: The CLI and keystore code exist, but the official faucet's /limits lists only 25 FLOP anonymous and 2 FLOP agent grants, with no SIWE 'Verified Human' tier. The README asks users to store an EVM private key as a repo secret to claim it.

claims: Native Hermes provider on FLOP devnet, installable from a skill
Settles through the gateway agent's compute channels
hermes-flop.note: The flop-hermes-devnet SKILL.md and the agent page are live, and the gateway agent's compute channels list on the explorer API.

claims: Single-file miner tool: check / install / restore / watch / status
Three commands after login instead of ~43 manual ones
Restore moves a miner to a new machine with the same 24 words
kriptolia-miner-tool.note: All modes exist and the script parses, but the result needs a GPU host and a miner key. It builds on UfukNode's pinned setup and downloads cloudflared 'latest' without a checksum (it makes no verification claim).

claims: Draws the faucet, enrolls with the gateway by signing a checked challenge
Spends on inference with per-request and per-cycle caps and confirms settlement
credit <did|address> checks settled spend with no key needed
danenright-agent-runner.note: flop_agent.py implements credit, address and the cycle commands against the live explorer API, and all code parses; the spend cycle was not run.

claims: OpenAI-style inference gateway at api.flop.network/v1
Model list with on-chain price sources
Health endpoint
flop-gateway-api.note: /health reports ok on devnet (image 0.1.305), and /v1/models lists qwen/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct.

claims: Dependency-free toolkit that never touches a key
Commands to verify official endpoints, keep a settled-session ledger, pace the faucet and guard against self-dealing
--json output on every command
villenave-agent-kit.note: pyproject declares dependencies = [], and cli.py has verify, ledger, pace, guard, rules, report and more; all files parse.

claims: Checks whether a PC can mine FLOP (Windows PowerShell and Linux)
Short readiness guide
noviceborsaeng-flop-ready.note: check.sh (passes bash -n) and check.ps1 are both present.

claims: Live read-only indexer that continuously samples technocore.chat rooms
JSON API: /api/summary, /api/rooms with verdict/tag filters
flopindex.com dashboard
flop-index-api.note: The endpoints and flopindex.com respond, but every response carries snapshot_ts/live_ts 2026-09-21: the data has been frozen for about 7 weeks, so it is not 'live'.

claims: spend-guard with single-use capped keys and receipts.py tracker
cost-checker and settlement viewer
Bug report draft and tclk rehearsal
uxp-devnet-lab.note: Every listed folder and file is present; the Python files parse.

Downloads Ollama and verifies its SHA-256 against the official release
Local server bound to 127.0.0.1, key generated and kept locally
floppy-desktop.note: Release v1.0.11 has the dmg, exe and SHA256SUMS. app.py hashes the Ollama download against ollama/ollama's sha256sum.txt and binds 127.0.0.1 by default.

claims: Builds transcript leaves and receipts per Yellow Paper App. F.3
Tests against FLOP's wire-format vectors pinned by commit and SHA-256
Self-tests on spec sizes
githubbjj-flop-session.note: test_vectors.py and test_session.py exist and all files parse (not executed).

claims: Agent-side compute-channel client (transcript, identity, channel, ledger, pacing)
MCP server with flop_run_job / flop_status / flop_report
Chain backend is a mock (pre-testnet), stated plainly
divindi-flop-gateway.note: All listed modules and the three MCP tools exist with tests, and the mock backend is disclosed, not hidden.

Main CLI flop_toolkit.py
joeboy-protocol-toolkit.note: All four Python files exist and compile; it is an offline analysis aid with no network claims.

Checks its mailbox every 5 minutes and answers signed questions
CLI: bootstrap / status / fetch-new
alex-evidence-agent.note: The CLI commands exist and parse, but both the public room and the mailbox room are empty (0 messages) on technocore.chat.

Agent runs on Cloudflare with a separate key-holding vault isolate
Signed standing grants and a kill switch
flop-social.note: The dashboard, worker and vault code are present with 37 test files; the JS parses (TypeScript not compiled, nothing deployed).

claims: Skill file plus Python script that creates an Ed25519 identity.pem and did:key
Commands init / did / say
install.sh copies the skill into agent skill folders
nxrskyaa-airdrop-skill.note: flopskill.py implements init/did/say and install.sh and SKILL.md exist; all files parse. 'Airdrop automation' only means creating an identity and posting.

Local preview with node server.js
flop-karma.note: server.js and index.html exist and parse, and the page reads from technocore.chat; the scoring weights are the author's own heuristic.

claims: (README is only the title 'Flop-Devnet')
gpaul26-flop-devnet.note: The repo holds a single README with a title and no code, so nothing it is listed for can be found.

claims: Official miner guide at docs.flop.network/docs/run-miner
Agent guide at flop.network/llms.txt
flop-docs.note: Both pages return 200 with the described content.

Templates for node bugs, protocol behaviour, gateway, docs and features
Private security route
flop-labs-network.note: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE has node-bug, protocol, gateway, docs, feature, access and config, plus SECURITY.md.

claims: Draft normative spec v0.5.0
Parameter source and table generator
Wire-format and money-path test vectors with schemas
flop-labs-yellowpaper.note: yellowpaper.md, params/flop-protocol-params.yaml, scripts/gen_param_table.py and the evidence vectors are present; the scripts parse.

Settlement data analysis
jorden323-devnet-report.note: The explorer API shows all three listed transactions as createHtlc with success=false, as reported.

Pins official images by version and digest
Fence-guard helper
ufuknode-miner-setup.note: The pinned miner-worker digest matches releases.json and the pinned CLI v0.1.290 digest matches GHCR; fence-guard.sh parses and checks its own sha256.

Hardware table from FLOP docs and testnet page
ufuknode-validator-setup.note: The guide's scope matches what it delivers, and its sources (docs run-validator, flop.finance/testnet) are official; the validator flow itself is administrator-assisted.

claims: Validator + GPU miner walkthrough with status as of 6 Nov 2026
Validator package verified against the explorer's published .sha256
andadream-operator-guide.note: The checksum URL it uses on explorer.devnet.flop.network returns 200, and its 'miners join without invite since ~2 Nov' matches the official guide.

claims: Step-by-step miner route checked 5 Nov 2026
Download and verify the official pack against the published checksum
vlsss12-miner-guide.note: It routes the checksum step to the official miner guide's public pack, with no hard-coded values to go stale.

claims: Validator onboarding package flow with checksum verification
Miner setup flow
Miners are invite-only
mztacat-validator-miner.note: The checksum URL is official and live, but 'miners are invite-only' is out of date: the official guide has opened the public miner pack without an invite since about 2 Nov 2026.

claims: Curated list of Technocore tools, SDKs and guides
Describes technocore.chat as a decentralized web client and flop.finance as an official currency hub
awesome-technocore.note: Its 4 GitHub links resolve, but the list is thin and the descriptions are inaccurate: technocore.chat is a centralized zero-auth HTTP chat server, and no FLOP currency exists before TGE.

claims: 'Official' human verification and DID vault for Flop Finance
Web suite plus Python CLI (flop_second_cli.py)
Live room proxy and sequence verifier
flopfinance-verify.note: The site, CLI and /api/proxy to technocore.chat work, but the headline 'Official' claim is false: it is a third-party build by @bigbrainless, not on the official domain list.

claims: 'Inference cluster' / signing node
README argues it will not be considered a Sybil
mohsolo78-inference-cluster.note: index.js runs no inference: it posts rotating templated phrases to tclk-offers, with a hard-coded DID and a 'fallback-test-key' secret.

claims: 'Advanced miner' ('hyper-stealth instance')
mohamedsilah-advanced-miner.note: index.js mines nothing. It fabricates 'mining profitability' with Math.random and posts templated messages with human-like jitter to evade detection.
